name: CoverImage
description: Fixed-aspect media cover that shows the image when present and a deterministic seed-derived token gradient when the entity has no art.
designIntent: Media cards need a cover that never looks broken: imageless entities still get an intentional, per-entity placeholder instead of a reused generic social card. CoverImage wraps Image's src->fallback chain inside an aspect-ratio box so grids stay aligned and never shift layout.

props.name: src
props.description: Cover URL. When absent or broken, the seeded fallback renders instead.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Aspect ratio: presets map to 16:9, 1:1 and 2:1; any CSS aspect-ratio value like '16/10' also works.

props.name: seed
props.description: Stable key selecting the fallback gradient (e.g. entity slug), so the same entity always gets the same placeholder.

props.name: priority
props.description: Load eagerly and fetch at high priority for the LCP image.

props.name: sizes
props.description: Responsive sizes hint forwarded to the image element.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Custom fallback content; defaults to the seed-derived token gradient.

props.name: mark
props.description: Optional mark (icon, monogram) centered on the default gradient.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes merged onto the aspect-ratio container.

examples.title: Entity cover with seeded placeholder
examples.description: 16:9 cover; imageless events get a stable per-slug gradient.

examples.title: Square avatar-style cover
examples.description: Square cover with a mark on the gradient fallback.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for photos of people
antiPatterns.explanation: Use Avatar for people and firms; CoverImage is for media covers (events, articles, listings).

antiPatterns.title: Don't skip the seed
antiPatterns.explanation: Without a stable seed the fallback falls back to alt text, so two entities can share a gradient by accident. Pass the entity slug.

accessibility.implementation: Renders a real img with alt when src is present; the gradient fallback is aria-hidden decoration
accessibility.userRequirements: Always pass a descriptive alt; the placeholder is not content

accessibility.implementation: The aspect-ratio box reserves space before the image loads, so grids never shift
accessibility.userRequirements: Pick the aspect that matches the card design

guidelines: Describe the image, not the component
For decorative covers paired with a title, keep alt concise

compositionRules.relationship: CoverImage is the media slot at the top of a Card or listing tile
CoverImage wraps Image, inheriting its src->fallbackSrc->fallback resilience chain
